title: Shower Squeegee Solid Brass 15-Inch H With Wall Hook | Squeegee Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Stop water spots and streaks before they dry on your shower door, tile, and mirrors. This shower squeegee clears moisture in quick, easy strokes and stores neatly on the included decorative wall hook.

Highlights:
- Keep glass and tile spot-free after every shower with a smooth, easy-glide blade
- Store it within reach with the included mounting hook for secure support when properly installed
- Choose a coordinated look with the distinctive Squeegee collection—made to complement transitional bathroom hardware
- Built for everyday bathroom use with solid brass construction and a replaceable blade

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 15 x 10 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 16 x 10 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall-mounted hook included
- Finish options: multiple designer finish options available
